changed.item: 'regular routes' became 'regular ... delivery needs', which loses the specific idea of covering routes
'cover regular routes or last-minute delivery needs' became 'some of your regular or last minute delivery needs', which narrows the scope to only part of their needs
'15 minutes' became 'about 15 minutes', which softens the time ask
'discuss where we might fit' became 'see if there's a fit', which shifts the framing from exploring where they fit to whether they fit at all

added.item: 'We do a lot of refrigerated trucking' adds an unsupported claim about volume or scale
